notes: The native-feel pass. Android now navigates like Android: real push/pop transitions (incoming screen slides in, outgoing parallax-fades back) that scrub under the Android 14+ predictive-back gesture, and the chat transcript's keyboard now tracks your finger downward as you drag — exactly like the platform chat apps. Committed sends, long-press reveals and copy confirmations answer with the system's own touch ticks. iOS behaves like iOS: the keyboard in chat now follows your finger interactively instead of vanishing on touch, the Taptic Engine answers sends, copies, pins, deletes and the voice hold-threshold with real haptics (and the Settings Haptics toggle now actually controls them), and every font scales with your Dynamic Type setting. Same design, same features — each platform simply feels like it was built for it.
